title: News from JMonkeyEngine - 20 March 2022
content:
As of today, there's a new release of JMonkeyEngine: 3.5.1-stable, which improves our support for the new "Apple Silicon" Macs and fixes a couple recently-discovered bugs.

Behind the scenes, discussion about the future of JMonkeyEngine is underway. It's too soon to present a roadmap, but know we aren't satisfied to rest on our laurels.

Financially, the project is very stable. Thanks again for your financial contribution(s), which give us confidence to move forward.

For the latest news and discussion of JMonkeyEngine software development,
visit the Development category at the JME Hub/Forum: https://hub.jmonkeyengine.org/c/development-discussion-jme3/9
